title: Systematic's depth is in defence and healthcare, around products it owns
content:
Systematic is an Aarhus firm with deep defence and healthcare capability, and its record notes it owns products in both. Depth in two sovereignty-exposed verticals is the qualifying half of that; owning the products in them is the disqualifying half.

Defence and healthcare are where verifiable, controlled records matter most, so the vertical exposure points the right way. But a product owner in those verticals already occupies the application layer, which places Systematic in the same category as the other product-owning leads in this set. Its open-source posture was not researched, and it sits at priority 4.
